ruleDefinitions.name: Remote File Download Via Desktopimgdownldr Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the desktopimgdownldr utility being used to download a remote file. An adversary may use desktopimgdownldr to download arbitrary files as an alternative to certutil.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\desktopimgdownldr\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\desktopimgdownldr\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/lockscreenurl\\:http.*"))
